markdown-for-agents.title: Markdown for Agents
markdown-for-agents.subtitle: Automatically convert HTML to Markdown for requests that use content negotiation headers (Accept: text/markdown).
markdown-for-agents.status.enabledHint: On for %{zone}. Agents that ask for Markdown get it.
markdown-for-agents.status.noEditPermiss: You need permission to edit zone settings to change this.
markdown-for-agents.status.disabledTitle: Markdown for Agents is turned off for this zone
markdown-for-agents.status.disabledDescr: Use the switch above to turn it on. Configuration Rules can still turn it on for specific hostnames or paths, so you may still see conversions.
markdown-for-agents.status.freeTitle: Markdown for Agents requires a Pro plan or higher
markdown-for-agents.status.freeDescripti: Upgrade this zone to convert HTML to Markdown for AI agents.
markdown-for-agents.analytics.errorTitle: We couldn’t load Markdown for Agents analytics
markdown-for-agents.analytics.errorDescr: Analytics may not be available for this zone yet. Try again in a few minutes.
markdown-for-agents.analytics.sampleDesc: Markdown for Agents analytics aren’t available yet, so this development build shows synthetic data.
markdown-for-agents.analytics.noAccessTi: You don’t have access to analytics for this zone
markdown-for-agents.analytics.noAccessDe: Ask an administrator for a role that can read zone analytics. You can still use the Playground.
markdown-for-agents.analytics.metrics.co: Estimated conversion attempts from AI agents that requested text/markdown.
markdown-for-agents.analytics.metrics.su: Share of conversions that completed without hitting a content limit.
markdown-for-agents.analytics.metrics.to: How much smaller the Markdown is than the HTML, for full conversions.
markdown-for-agents.analytics.metrics.pa: Conversions that completed but lost some content to a content limit: input truncated, front matter omitted, or JSON-LD omitted.
markdown-for-agents.analytics.metrics.fa: Conversions that failed or never finished. These requests may have received HTML instead.
markdown-for-agents.analytics.overTime.t: Estimated conversion attempts by outcome. Full: no content limit was hit. Partial: some content was left out. Completed (unverified): the outcome could not be confirmed. Failed: the conversion stopped with an error. Unfinished: the stream ended without a result.
markdown-for-agents.analytics.overTime.e: No conversions in this time range.
markdown-for-agents.analytics.limits.too: Completed conversions that left content out. A conversion can hit more than one limit.
markdown-for-agents.analytics.limits.emp: No conversions hit a content limit.
markdown-for-agents.analytics.topPages.e: No pages were converted in this time range.
markdown-for-agents.analytics.topUserAge: User agents are reported by the client and are not verified bot identities.
No user agents in this time range.
markdown-for-agents.analytics.notConvert: Pages whose conversions failed or lost content to a limit.
No partial or failed conversions in this time range.
markdown-for-agents.analytics.errorCodes: No failed conversions in this time range.
markdown-for-agents.logs.emptyDescriptio: Conversions appear here when AI agents request your pages with Accept: text/markdown.
markdown-for-agents.logs.filteredEmptyDe: Try different filters or a longer time range.
markdown-for-agents.logs.limitReached: Showing the %{count} most recent results. Narrow the time range or filters to see older conversions.
markdown-for-agents.logs.sampled: Logs are sampled. Requests shows the estimated number of requests each row represents.
markdown-for-agents.playground.title: Test a page
markdown-for-agents.playground.descripti: Request a page on this zone with Accept: text/markdown, the same way an AI agent would, and compare it with the HTML version.
markdown-for-agents.playground.invalidPa: Enter a path that starts with /, like /blog/my-post.
markdown-for-agents.playground.disabledN: Markdown for Agents is turned off for this zone, so pages are only converted where a Configuration Rule turns it on.
markdown-for-agents.playground.notConver: The response was %{contentType} with HTTP %{status}. Markdown for Agents may be off for this hostname or path, the page may not be HTML, or the HTML may be larger than 6 MiB.
markdown-for-agents.playground.blocked.t: Your browser couldn’t read this page
markdown-for-agents.playground.blocked.d: The page doesn’t allow the Cloudflare dashboard to read its responses (CORS), or it couldn’t be reached. Run this command to see the Markdown response:
markdown-for-agents.playground.timeout.d: The page took too long to respond. Try again, or run this command to see the Markdown response:
markdown-for-agents.playground.metrics.e: Estimated as response bytes divided by 4.
markdown-for-agents.playground.metrics.r: How much smaller the Markdown response is than the HTML response.
markdown-for-agents.playground.output.tr: Showing the first %{size} of the response. Run the command above to see the full response.
